# skills-sync Skill

Managed shared skills are marked with `managed-by: psc-shared-skills` in their
frontmatter. Update only marked skills from the platform shared-skills template.

Do not delete or overwrite repository-specific skills that do not carry the
managed marker. Report local modifications before replacing a managed skill.
